description:
Join messages are messages that Wynem sends when members join or leave the server. There are three types that you can set up: a join message that gets sent to a channel with a generated welcome image, a leave message that does the same when a member leaves, and a join DM that gets sent directly to new members.

All of the join message commands require the **Manage Server** permission.
The join message, leave message, and join DM all support handlebars. Place these in the message text to have them replaced when the message gets sent:

rows: The bot's prefix in the server

tabs.name: Setting the join message
content: To set the join message, use the <command:setjoinmessage [channel] [message]|serverconfig joinmessages setjoinmessage channel:[channel] message:[message]> command. The channel is where the join messages will be sent, and the message can be up to 64 characters long. The message is optional, and defaults to `Everyone welcome: {{name}}`.
For example: <command:setjoinmessage #welcome Everyone welcome: {{name}}|serverconfig joinmessages setjoinmessage channel:#welcome message:Everyone welcome: {{name}}>
You will be shown a preview of the join message, with you as the member joining.

data.title: Join message set
data.description: Here is a preview of the new join message:

embeds.description: You can set a custom background image with the `e!setjoinimage` command

content: The join message is now set up! Whenever a member joins the server, the join message will be sent to the chosen channel with a welcome image generated from your message text and the member's avatar.
If the channel the join message sends to gets deleted, the join message is automatically removed.

tabs.name: Setting the join image
content: To give the join message a custom background image, use the <command:setjoinimage|serverconfig joinmessages setjoinimage image-file:[image]> command, providing the image as an attachment or an image URL. The image is resized to fit between 256×256 and 1,024×1,024.
A join message must be set before you can set a join image. If there is no join message set, you will get an error.

tabs.name: Setting the join DM
content: To set a message that gets sent directly to new members when they join, use the <command:setjoindm [message]|serverconfig joinmessages setjoindm message:[message]> command. The message is required, and can be up to 1,024 characters long.
For example: <command:setjoindm Welcome to the server {{name}}! Make sure to read the rules!|serverconfig joinmessages setjoindm message:Welcome to the server {{name}}! Make sure to read the rules!>

content: The join DM is now set up, and will be sent to members when they join the server.
Join DMs are never sent to bots, and members who have their DMs disabled will not receive one.

tabs.name: Setting the leave message
content: To set the leave message, use the <command:setleavemessage [channel] [message]|serverconfig joinmessages setleavemessage channel:[channel] message:[message]> command. The channel is where the leave messages will be sent, and the message can be up to 64 characters long. The message is optional, and defaults to `Goodbye {{name}}`.
For example: <command:setleavemessage #welcome Goodbye {{name}}|serverconfig joinmessages setleavemessage channel:#welcome message:Goodbye {{name}}>

A leave message must be set before you can set a leave image. If there is no leave message set, you will get an error.

tabs.name: Viewing the join messages
content: To view the join messages currently set up in the server, use the <command:viewjoinmessages|serverconfig joinmessages view> command. It will show a preview of the join message, leave message, and join DM, depending on which of them are set up.

tabs.name: Removing join messages
content: To remove the join message, leave message, or join DM, use the <command:removejoinmessage|serverconfig joinmessages removejoinmessage>, <command:removeleavemessage|serverconfig joinmessages removeleavemessage>, or <command:removejoindm|serverconfig joinmessages removejoindm> commands.
You will be prompted to confirm the removal, along with a preview of the message being removed. For example, when removing the join message:

data.description: Are you sure you want to remove the join message from the server?

content: After confirming, the join message will have been removed.

description: When Wynem first joins a server, it sends an informational message to help you get started. You can resend this message at any time with the <command:resendjoininfo|serverconfig resendjoininfo> command, and it will be sent in the current channel. This command requires the **Manage Server** permission.

data.title: Thanks for inviting me to Wynem Support
data.description: Here is some information to help get you started!
fields: To view a list of all main features that you can use, visit [wynem.com](https://wynem.com/features/)
To view all of the available commands, you can use <:/help>, or visit [wynem.com](https://wynem.com/commands/)

Bot notices will bring you the latest news and updates about Wynem.
To receive bot notices, you can join [this server](https://discord.gg/pkRxtGw) and follow the `#wynem-notices` channel, follow Wynem on [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/wynem.com), or use the <:/bot notices> command
If you need support with the bot, join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/pkRxtGw) and we can help you there!
To suggest command/feature ideas for Wynem, please use the <:/bot suggest> command
If you find a bug with Wynem, please report it with the <:/bot bugreport> command
Please make sure to keep up to date with the [Terms of Service](https://wynem.com/terms/) and the [Privacy Policy](https://wynem.com/privacy/)
